---
title: "Publication-size figure audit"
format: html
execute:
  enabled: false
---

Read-only audit of the current vector masters. A provisional 180 mm full-width
layout and 6 pt minimum ordinary text are editorial screening targets, not
journal requirements. Subscripts may legitimately be smaller; every flag still
requires visual review. Passing this screen alone does not prove legibility.
No source figure or live document is modified. Earlier versions remain intact.

```sh
python scripts/run_python_qmd.py manuscript/figure_publication_size_audit.qmd OUTPUT_DIRECTORY
```

```{python}
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import pdfplumber

repo = Path.cwd()
root = Path('/Users/shaman.narayanasamy/Work/data/phage_uv_treatment/PRJEB79569/derived')
out = Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve()
if out.exists():
    raise SystemExit('Refusing to overwrite an audit directory')
sources = [
    {'label': 'Figure 1', 'path': 'community_figure_publication_2026-09-09-v4/figures/community-structure-figure-one.pdf'},
    {'label': 'Figure 2', 'path': 'manuscript_figures_publication_2026-09-09-v2/figures/global-transcriptome-structure.pdf'},
    {'label': 'Figure 3', 'path': 'manuscript_figures_publication_2026-09-09-v2/figures/functional-organism-restructuring.pdf'},
    {'label': 'Figure 4', 'path': 'recurrence_figure_publication_2026-09-09-v2/figures/recurrent-gene-structure.pdf'},
    {'label': 'Figure 5', 'path': 'population_figure_publication_2026-09-09-v2/figures/population-genomic-heterogeneity.pdf'},
]
sources += json.loads((repo/'manuscript/supplementary_report_sources.json').read_text())['figures']
# Publication masters can lead the separately versioned companion. Keep the
# companion's currently released source specification unchanged until its next
# complete rebuild, while screening the current checked master for S1-S5 here.
for item in sources:
    if item['label'] in ['S1', 'S2', 'S3', 'S4', 'S5']:
        item['path'] = 'supplementary_figures_publication_2026-09-09-v2/figures/' + Path(item['path']).name
    if item['label'] in ['S6', 'S7']:
        item['path'] = 'taxonomic_figures_publication_2026-09-09-v3/figures/' + Path(item['path']).name
    if item['label'] == 'S8':
        item['path'] = 'network_figure_publication_2026-09-09-v2/figures/host-phage-network-evidence-audit.pdf'
    if item['label'] == 'S9':
        item['path'] = 'abundance_figure_publication_2026-09-09-v2/figures/community-differential-abundance.pdf'
assert len(sources) == 15
if len(sys.argv) > 2:
    sources.append({'label': 'Figure 1 candidate', 'path': sys.argv[2]})
for item in sources:
    if not (root/item['path']).is_file():
        raise SystemExit(f'Missing source: {item}')
out.mkdir(parents=True)
records = []
for item in sources:
    source = root/item['path']
    with pdfplumber.open(source) as pdf:
        assert len(pdf.pages) == 1, item
        page = pdf.pages[0]
        scale = (180/25.4*72)/float(page.width)
        chars = [c for c in page.chars if c['text'].strip()]
        # pdfminer reports vertical glyph advance as size for rotated text.
        # For 90-degree axis labels, bbox width is the true nominal font size.
        def text_size(c):
            return float(c['size'] if c['upright'] else c['width'])
        sizes = sorted(text_size(c)*scale for c in chars)
        tiny = [c for c in chars if text_size(c)*scale < 6]
        record = dict(label=item['label'], path=str(source),
            sha256=hashlib.sha256(source.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), bytes=source.stat().st_size,
            width_mm=round(float(page.width)/72*25.4,2), height_mm=round(float(page.height)/72*25.4,2),
            proposed_width_mm=180, scaled_height_mm=round(float(page.height)*scale/72*25.4,2),
            scale=scale, nonspace_characters=len(chars), raster_objects=len(page.images),
            minimum_scaled_text_pt=round(min(sizes),2) if sizes else None,
            median_scaled_text_pt=round(sizes[len(sizes)//2],2) if sizes else None,
            below_6pt_characters=len(tiny), below_6pt_fraction=round(len(tiny)/max(1,len(chars)),3),
            small_text_sample=''.join(c['text'] for c in tiny)[:180],
            visual_status='pending', font_report=subprocess.run(['pdffonts',str(source)],check=True,capture_output=True,text=True).stdout)
        records.append(record)
        print(item['label'], record['width_mm'], record['minimum_scaled_text_pt'], record['median_scaled_text_pt'], record['below_6pt_fraction'], flush=True)
    if item['label'] in ['Figure 1','Figure 2','Figure 3','S6','S8','Figure 1 candidate']:
        subprocess.run(['pdftoppm','-singlefile','-scale-to-x','1063','-scale-to-y','-1','-png',str(source),str(out/item['label'].replace(' ','-'))],check=True,capture_output=True)
    (out/'audit.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(target_width_mm=180,minimum_text_screen_pt=6,
        boundary='Editorial screen, not journal conformance or visual acceptance; live preview provenance must be checked separately',figures=records),indent=2)+'\n')
```
